title: Large API results through the vault reach agents as a file notice, not data
whatHappens: A vault HTTP call with a large response returns a saved-file notice instead of structured data, and a large request body is refused at 64 KB, so agents fall back to shell parsing.

observations.text: Feedback, 3-4 Nov: 7 reports from 1 agent (Sentry and GitHub reads, one insights publish over the request limit).
